question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**junctures**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes an experience where the movement is steady, with occasional changes in direction or pace.
 
• The word "junctures" is appropriate because it refers to specific points or moments where something changes or occurs, fitting the context of the movement described.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Times (समय): "Times" refers to periods, but it does not fit well in the context of describing specific points of change in direction or movement.
 
• Periods (अवधियाँ): "Periods" indicates spans of time, which does not convey the idea of distinct moments or changes.
 
• Season (मौसम): "Season" refers to a time of the year, which does not match the context of movement or ascent described in the passage.
